title: example-targets runtime R2: the upstream-build route rerun on 105's two commons-numbers commits, with the runtime classpath's scope filter applied
description: A rerun of 20261114-170353, which passed but recorded test-scope JARs (JUnit 5.14.4, opentest4j, apiguardian, commons-rng 1.7) as commons-numbers-core's runtime dependencies: runtime_upstream.py passed -Dmdep.includeScope=runtime to maven-dependency-plugin 3.9.0's build-classpath, whose descriptor names that filter's user property includeScope, so the filter was ignored and the listing was the test classpath. It now passes -DincludeScope=runtime and records the scope. The rest is as before: each exact commit of apache/commons-numbers fetched from github.com into an isolated checkout (after's recorded parent checked), the 105 sidecar's recipe (mvn --projects commons-numbers-core ... package) run by the installed Maven 3.10.0 on JDK 11, both by full path, with Maven Central as the one repository, a fresh local repository and --strict-checksums; the one produced non-auxiliary JAR holding ArithmeticUtils taken as the original; then runtime_numbers/'s adapter and driver run pow(int, int) in a separate JVM per commit on JDK 21 and 25 over 45 probes, read by a Javadoc oracle. The slice now plans from a copy of the case folder (ATTEMPT/case), where ingestion would publish receipts. Step 2 deletes the checkouts so that only the records come back.
expected: step 1 exits 0 and prints 'ok': prepare before and after artifacts-ready, each classpath exactly original (built/commons-numbers-core-1.4-SNAPSHOT.jar), adapter and driver, with no dependency (commons-numbers-core has no compile or runtime dependency), slice.json's preparations[*].built.dependencies.command ending -DincludeScope=runtime; four controls (before and after, JDK 21 and 25) exited 0 with 45 observations each; oracle problems exactly [-2, 31] on before and none on after; JDKs agree on each commit; ingestion at workflow's Phase 0 stub. Step 2 exits 0

resources.notes: the earlier run took 59 s and peaked at 858 MiB: two Maven builds of one small module and four short JVM runs; network to github.com and Maven Central
